Title: Private preview of Service Fabric on Linux

Body.Content: We are committed to enabling you to use Azure Service Fabric however and wherever you like. Today, we are taking another major step in that direction by opening a private preview of Service Fabric on Linux, including Java language support for stateless and actor services. In addition to running internally for many years, the Service Fabric private preview program has been operating with customers for more than a year. More than 300 customers have used it to build applications and services. To learn more about our plans for Linux and to sign up to be considered for the preview, see Service Fabric on Linux.
Body.Markdown:
We are committed to enabling you to use Azure Service Fabric however and wherever you like. Today, we are taking another major step in that direction by opening a private preview of Service Fabric on Linux, including Java language support for stateless and actor services.

In addition to running internally for many years, the Service Fabric private preview program has been operating with customers for more than a year. More than 300 customers have used it to build applications and services.

To learn more about our plans for Linux and to sign up to be considered for the preview, see Service Fabric on Linux .
